verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Plaid serves an llms.txt at plaid.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a Plaid summary header). The cited docs pages are served as per-page markdown (e.g. /docs/auth/index.html.md), which gives agents machine-readable docs; the 404 at /docs/.md covers only one candidate path. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's depth and coverage beyond its header, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
